tenderSchedule.title: Providing Security Services to premises of University of Mysore, Mysuru for the period of one year.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Successful tenderer shall prepare the statement of each Security Supervisor and Security Guards and submit the service bills on first of every succeeding month to the university, The University after due verification regarding the Memo of Calculation submitted by the Tenderer (bifurcating the increase as Basic Pay, DA, EPF, Service Tax and Agency Commission) shall effect the payment to the Tenderer by a single cheque. The Tenderer shall comply with all the statutory requirements like EPF, ESI, Service Tax, etc., the Tenderer shall pay the salary to the security personnel engaged by him through online process with due intimation to the university. Further, the Tenderer shall also furnish the copy of the documents pertaining to the statutory made by him.
Registrar is at liberty to interview suitable tenderers including their supervisory level personnel and for negotiating the rates as beneficial to Institution
Only well-versed Security Supervisor and Security Guards should be deployed for duty.

Bio-Data & Police verification Certificates in respect of all the personnel should be furnished by the successful agency, before commencement of work. The Successful agency should ensure that personnel deployed for Security in University, should be free from criminal cases.
Any security personnel deployed if found indulging in criminal activities should be immediately replaced.
The Agency shall be responsible for the discipline and good conduct and behavior of all the personnel deployed by them.

The successful tenderer should deposit a Security Deposit (5% of tendered amount) as per the university requirement. This will be refunded without interest after satisfactory completion of contract period.
The Agency shall be responsible for any acts of commission and omission of their employees.

The Agency shall be fully responsible for the security of all the properties of the University. In case of any theft, loss or damage to any property of the University due to negligence of Security personnel, the entire value of the loss will be recovered from the agency after giving an opportunity of being heard by the Registrar or any other officer empowered by him/her who shall assess the value of the property.
The Security staff deployed should have minimum knowledge to read and write in the local language.
The University will not provide any domestic accommodation to the Security personnel deployed to University.

General conditions: The duration of the contract is for 12 months, extendable for a period of 06 months by mutual consent with the same terms and conditions of the agreement executed. However, the contract can be terminated by either party on three months notice
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted and are treated as substantially not responsive.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender Processing shall not be refundable.
Bank Guarantee will not be acceptable for EMD. EMD should be paid as specified in the e-procurement schedule.
The authority reserves the rights to ACCEPT or REJECT any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

The University of Mysore does not bind itself to accept the lowest bidder and this university reserves the right to accept or reject any of the Tender or all the Tenderers without assigning the reasons.

Tenderer should submit an undertaking in an Rs.100/- Judicial e-Stamp Paper that there is no legal cases against the Agency before any of the statutory bodies for non compliance with minimum wages, rules, Labour act and payment of ESI and PF.
Very Imp: Other Important Terms & conditions and Eligibility Criteria is Uploaded Separately. Bidder should read those conditions before bidding.
The variation DA(VDA) will be paid as and when the variation is noticed by the Government and the same should be paid to the Security Guard/Personal.
IMP NOTE: Bidders are requested to refer the terms and Conditions uploaded separately.
Very Important: Bidders must go through the Tender Document for detailed terms and conditions before bidding.
